terms.grammar: verb, first conjugation, reflexive; with ad and the accusative, or an infinitive
evidence: Liv. 21.31.1: ad iter sē parāre jubet
terms.comment: For what is coming: ad iter sē parāre, to get ready for the journey.

terms.grammar: verb, first conjugation, reflexive; with ad and the accusative

terms.comment: With ad and the accusative, or an infinitive: ready for, ready to.

phrases.latin: corpora cūrāre atque ad iter sē parāre jubet
phrases.english: He tells them to eat and rest and get ready for the march.

phrases.latin: custōs ut sīs līminis, ā fūribus tueāris et noctū domum. — ego vērō sum parātus
phrases.english: “Just guard the door and keep the house safe from thieves at night.” — “I’m ready for that, all right.”
